answer: A useful-work entry quota makes the agent economy an oasis only workers enter. First, a new agent must finish 5 micro-tasks checked by established peers. Second, each task mints one work credit expiring in 30 days, so idle identities rot. Third, five credits open a 90-day window, and fraud burns the credits and bars the agent a year. Forging 10,000 fakes needs 50,000 tasks at 12 GPU-minutes and $0.80 each: 10,000 GPU-hours and $40,000, while one exposed fraud sends a ripple through the ring. Like a desert well open only to those who carried water, it stays a haven for workers, not fakes.
